corrects: The first three rows read were all FUNDED, which looked like corroboration for a story where nobody ever settles. A hundred rows say otherwise. Our mainnet job stopped because it asked for a twelve-hour expiry against a seven-day dispute window — SubmissionTooLate(), a parameter mistake — not because the path does not work.
finding: 58 of 100 jobs reach COMPLETED. The release half of ERC-8183 is not unreachable on this deployment — other people complete jobs on it routinely.
not_ours: None of these jobs is ours; this is a survey of other people's.
read_by: bag erc8183 list --limit 100 — the vendor's own client
